company_info.description: Softfront Holdings provides communication software services in Japan. It is involved in the development and sale of products and services related to real-time communication using voice, video, messaging, and related commissioned development, as well as brokerage sale of IT solutions. The company offers commubo, a natural conversation AI platform that uses voice robots instead of humans; telmee, a cloud-based telephone business automation service; and SITE PUBLIS, a content management system for website management. In addition, it engages in the planning, development, and sale of web-based products and services; website construction; and the provision of utilization support services. The company was formerly known as Softfront Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Softfront Holdings in August 2016. Softfront Holdings was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
